@graph.name: Index
@graph.description: Architectural notes. Mechanisms, constraints, and tests. Three working notes document the laboratory’s engineering principles. Each states a mechanism and the condition under which it should be tested. These are published notes, not claims of completed empirical research. The index covers Closed-Loop Digital Brutalism, Meden Agan, and post-interface semantic indexing.

@graph.name: Closed-Loop Digital Brutalism
@graph.description: A closed-loop document system keeps content, typography, assets, navigation, and entity identity under one controlled delivery path. A deployed page can be read and navigated without a third-party runtime. The mechanism is containment. Root-relative assets, explicit schemas, and native browser interactions reduce translation between source and public behavior. Each dependency must account for the capability it supplies and the failure state it introduces. Test: disable page scripts, inspect the request graph, follow every local route, and compare visible statements with the canonical entity graph.

@graph.name: Meden Agan
@graph.description: Nothing in excess. In software engineering, excess includes repeated state, duplicated DOM controls, conflicting style passes, and abstractions that conceal their output. Remove a layer when its result can be stated directly in the document or native platform. Preserve the layer when removal breaks a required capability. Reduction is measured against behavior, not line count. Test: compare responsive geometry, keyboard access, motion preferences, form behavior, and native navigation before and after removal.

@graph.name: Semantic indexing
@graph.description: An autonomous parser can encounter an entity graph before a person opens the interface. The document must therefore state identity, authorship, hierarchy, and current operating status in machine-readable form. The Universe API governs this macro-systems layer through canonical entity identifiers, explicit graph relationships, and deterministic data flow below the query layer. Public pages, JSON-LD, and agent routing must describe the same system. Test: resolve every @id, verify canonical routes, compare graph descriptions with surface copy, and distinguish proposed specifications from deployed systems.

@graph.name: Overview
@graph.description: 00 / Proof of work Lab 783, built as its own first client. The laboratory’s own platform records the architecture it describes: a controlled static delivery path, zero external runtime libraries, Fibonacci geometry, and canonical entity indexing through the Universe API .

@graph.name: Structural failure
@graph.description: The source had to carry the same identity to readers, browsers, and autonomous parsers. Earlier revisions accumulated layout overrides, repeated style payloads across routes, and inconsistent venture descriptions. Lab 783 calls the gap between an organization’s intended structure and its public output translation loss. Fonts and layout must remain under the laboratory’s control. Archivo and JetBrains Mono are controlled by the site, either embedded in a document or loaded as same-origin WOFF2 files. Homepage styles are inline; shared subpage styles come from the same origin. A network failure can still affect a resource, so the document retains readable content and native navigation without page scripts. Successive style passes redefined the same reading rails, type roles, and grids. The refactor consolidated those passes into one shared stylesheet and isolated the homepage opening in its own file. The founder, laboratory, retained studio, and acquisition specification needed stable identities. A canonical graph now gives each entity one declared @id, while the visible pages and agent files describe the same operating status.

@graph.name: Mandate
@graph.description: Meden Agan. Nothing in excess. Every layer must account for the behavior it supplies. Each route has one HTML document. The homepage keeps its CSS and native scripts inline. Subpages share their content stylesheet and observational page index. Monolith layout rules remain confined to the homepage. No frameworks, font services, trackers, or third-party runtime libraries are required. Native browser JavaScript handles the homepage motion, reading-position index, intake drafting, and the 783 Hz carrier. Content and navigation remain usable when JavaScript is disabled. Fibonacci tokens set the spatial base. The 12-column slab reserves two columns for section rails, eight for reading, and two for void. Approved optical values, touch targets, and the monolith’s exact geometry are retained. A compact projection of the canonical @graph is embedded in the homepage. Subpages embed the full graph, also published at schema.json . Root-level site.json , llms.txt , and sitemap.xml expose the same route and entity structure. Cloudflare Pages publishes the static site from the main-branch commit. The deployment check identifies the exact revision. Reading the public documents requires no application backend or database.

@graph.name: Architecture
@graph.description: Five layers. Each has a defined output and a verification boundary. Each page carries its own markup and metadata. The compact homepage inlines its CSS and native scripts and loads the original WOFF2 fonts from the same origin. Other routes use the shared reading stylesheet and embedded font declarations. Archivo retains weight 100 to 900 and width 62 to 125. JetBrains Mono retains weight 100 to 800. Both use font-display: block. styles.css defines the shared reading system for subpages. The homepage contains its own reduced inline stylesheet and native browser behaviors. Both preserve the same monolith geometry, font bytes, navigation semantics, and audio controls. A lazy Web Audio context creates one sine oscillator at 783 Hz. A gain node limits its peak to 0.018. The first pointer or keyboard gesture activates the carrier unless the visitor has muted it. The header control uses 35ms gain ramps and preserves the explicit mute preference in sessionStorage across site pages. No audio file or external library is loaded. This page’s Content-Security-Policy permits same-origin styles and script, its hashed embedded font stylesheet, and data-embedded fonts. It blocks external runtime origins and form submissions. The intake ledger remains a separate route. One token set governs the shared scale. H1 page titles occupy the reading axis. H2 section rails, H3 topic groups, and H4 supporting details express the document’s structure. type 13 21 34 55 space 8 13 21 34 55 89 144 233 ratios 1.618 2.618 slab 12 columns from 900px rail 1 / 3 reading 3 / 11 void 11 / 13 measure 55ch paragraphs opening 100svh Edge The publication unit is a set of static files served by Cloudflare Pages. Assets use canonical root-relative paths. Local resource boundaries and explicit routes keep delivery independent of a client-side router or rendering framework. The Universe API is the laboratory’s macro-systems architecture and deterministic indexing framework. Its public index layer identifies the author, publisher, organizations, pages, and sections below the query layer. argelysoriach.com/#person founder seveneightythree.com/#organization laboratory wild-lake.org/#organization retained studio communalfoundation.org/#organization research entity seveneightythree.com/case-study/#article case study Verification The static checks parse JSON and XML, resolve local assets and fragments, compare embedded graphs, and reject duplicate IDs or skipped heading levels. Browser checks cover responsive geometry, keyboard access, motion preferences, native history, intake drafting, and no-JavaScript behavior. The opening SVGs, font bytes, 1000ms arrival, and 860ms recoil remain unchanged. Repeated activation does not stack gestures, and a live reduced-motion change cancels active motion.
